record: National Heritage List for England, Moreton (Now Part of Grenville College), 1282978
facts: Grade II house, c1821 with earlier fabric. Solid rendered walls, slate hip roof, sash glazing and distinct front and rear chimneys. Site coordinate SS 43612 26308.
